# Lakes weekend

Two days around Buttermere, 14 and 15 June. We stay at the youth hostel on Saturday night.

## Route

Day one goes round the lake, about 7 km. Day two climbs Haystacks, about 9 km with 550 m of ascent.

## Bring

- Waterproofs and a warm layer
- Lunch for both days
- A sleeping bag liner for the hostel

## Emergency contacts

- Club emergency phone, carried on every walk: 07700 900123
- Club first-aider: Tom Okafor, 07700 900456
- Mountain rescue: call 999, ask for the police, then mountain rescue
- Club secretary, not on the walk: Ann Price, 07700 900789
